hints: Add up the pieces in every row from row 1 to row 3.
This is the same pattern as the triangular numbers: 1, 3, 6, 10, ...

canonical: The pile has 1 + 2 + 3 + ... + 3 pieces, one row for each of the 3 rows.
That sum is the 3th triangular number: n x (n + 1) / 2 with n = 3.

stem: mango pieces are stacked in a triangular pile: row 1 has 1 piece, row 2 has 2 pieces, and so on, each row one more than the last, up to row 3. How many mango pieces are in the pile in total?
